content.text: {"decision": "explain", "likely_cause": "Likely cause: in the item:list Scroll container, the user scrolls up and down repeatedly (scroll_y rises to 7850 then falls back to 2950 and 6050 with the pointer resting on the same \"Item 190\" row at x 1275, y 400) before any click, so the row appears to be located by scrolling rather than by a direct target.", "fix": "Fix: On the item:list screen, add a search or filter input above the Scroll container element so a row such as Item 190 can be reached without repeated scrolling up and down through the long list.", "cited_event_ids": ["443", "444", "445:118", "446", "447", "448:122", "449", "451", "452", "454"], "confidence": "med", "unsupported": ["Whether users were searching for Item 190 or for another row", "Whether the scrolling was intentional or was caused by the pointer position", "The page extent of at least 8762 px is not visible in the windows", "The effect of a search or filter on the outcome is not verified by these events"]}
